core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case and use faithful flatness (proof lines 3199-3212): since the completion map is faithfully flat, every prime of the affine source has a prime of the base change lying over it with a faithfully flat local map; if the prime does not lie over the maximal ideal then the corresponding local ring of the base change is normal by hypothesis, so the local ring of the source is normal by descent, showing that the source is normal away from the special fibre.

Produce a finite morphism with the right completion (proof lines 3214-3224): the completion is Nagata, so the normalization of the base change is finite and an isomorphism away from the special fibre; the formal glueing lemma applies because the completion map is flat and induces an isomorphism modulo the maximal ideal, and it produces a finite algebra over the source whose base change recovers the normalization of the base change.

Identify it with the normalization (proof lines 3224-3230): the resulting finite morphism is an isomorphism away from the special fibre, and at points of the special fibre the local rings map faithfully flatly to normal local rings of the base change, so they are normal by descent; hence the constructed scheme is normal and therefore is the normalization of the source, which is in particular finite.
proof_roadmap: Descend normality along the faithfully flat completion to see that the source is normal away from the special fibre.
Use finiteness of normalization over the Nagata completion and formal glueing to build a finite morphism over the source recovering it after completion.
Check normality at points of the special fibre by descent and identify the result with the normalization.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the complement of the special fibre in the base change along a completion is normal, then the normalization of the source is finite and its base change recovers the normalization of the base change (statement lines 3189-3197). The proof (proof lines 3199-3233) descends normality along the faithfully flat completion, uses finiteness of normalization over the Nagata completion together with formal glueing to produce a finite morphism over the source, and identifies it with the normalization after checking normality at the special fibre. H3: a descent and glueing argument with three inputs, written out in full.
